notes:
- **The recording bar now shows the microphone that is really recording.** If you saved a microphone in **Settings › Notes › Recording**, the bar's menu opens ticked on it, and its last line names the device that is open, instead of showing **Auto (Windows default)** and the headset. The Live window's pickers say the same thing in the same words. See [Choose the microphone and computer audio](/docs/recording-a-meeting/#choose-the-microphone-and-computer-audio).
- **Changing one side on the bar no longer moves the other.** Switching computer audio used to send the microphone back to the Windows default for that recording, and picking a microphone dropped a saved output device.
- **A saved device that isn't connected is said out loud.** The recording still starts on the Windows default, and the bar says "Your saved microphone isn't connected" once, with the device it is recording from. In Settings, the **Output device**, **Microphone (Me)** and **Dictation microphone** boxes show **Not connected · Windows default used** instead of going blank.
